stories.title: Arabia Saudita, gli Houthi attaccano una base aerea: colpito Eurofighter italiano. Crosetto: “Nessun ferito”

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Houthis attack air base: Italian Eurofighter hit. Crosetto: 'No injuries'
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked a Saudi air base where Italian military personnel are deployed on the Inherent Resolve mission, damaging an Italian Eurofighter. Italy's defense minister confirmed no personnel were injured and no other equipment was damaged.

stories.title: Studente spruzza spray urticante e accoltella insegnante a Roma

en.title: Student sprays irritant spray and stabs teacher in Rome
en.summary: A middle school student in Rome attacked a teacher with irritant spray and a knife. The teacher's injuries are not life-threatening and carabinieri responded to the incident.

stories.title: Roberto Vannacci a Torino per un convegno, centro blindato per un presidio contro il generale

en.title: Roberto Vannacci in Turin for conference, city center secured due to protest against general
en.summary: Roberto Vannacci, leader of Futuro Nazionale, attended an assembly on security in Turin while protesters gathered outside, chanting and throwing eggs. Police implemented security measures in the city center.

stories.title: Task Force Arabia, che cosa è lo scudo italiano nella base saudita di Taif sotto attacco

en.title: Task Force Arabia, what is the Italian shield at the Saudi base in Taif under attack
en.summary: Italy maintains a military task force at the Taif air base in Saudi Arabia, which came under attack resulting in damage to a Eurofighter. The article examines the composition and mission of Italian personnel stationed there.

stories.title: Studente spruzza spray urticante e accoltella insegnante a Roma: tentava di filmare l'aggressione

en.title: Student sprays irritant and stabs teacher in Rome: was attempting to film the assault
en.summary: A student at a middle school in Rome attacked a teacher with irritant spray and a knife while attempting to record the incident on a mobile phone. The teacher's injuries are not life-threatening.

stories.title: Vannacci a Torino, tensioni al presidio: uova contro le forze dell'ordine

en.title: Vannacci in Turin, tensions at protest: eggs thrown at police
en.summary: Protesters gathered outside a hotel hosting a security conference attended by a political figure, with some attempting to reach the venue while riot police maintained control of access points.

stories.title: Roma, studente di 13 anni accoltella la professoressa in classe e spruzza lo spray urticante

en.title: Rome, 13-year-old student stabs teacher in class and sprays irritant
en.summary: A 13-year-old student attacked a teacher at a middle school in Rome using a knife and irritant spray while recording the incident. The teacher sustained non-serious injuries.

stories.title: Vannacci a Torino, presidio antifascista davanti all'hotel del convegno sulla sicurezza, «Non è gradito»

en.title: Vannacci in Turin, antifascist protest outside hotel hosting security conference, "Not welcome"
en.summary: Approximately fifty protesters gathered outside a hotel in Turin where a political leader was attending a conference on urban insecurity, expressing opposition to his presence.

stories.title: Italian Eurofighter hit in attack on air base in Saudi Arabia says Crosetto

en.title: Italian Eurofighter hit in attack on air base in Saudi Arabia says Crosetto
en.summary: An Italian Eurofighter aircraft was damaged during an attack on an air base in Saudi Arabia, according to the defence minister. No Italian military personnel were injured in the incident.

stories.title: Attacchi a base aerea in Arabia, colpito Eurofighter italiano

en.title: Italian Eurofighter hit in attack on air base in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: An Italian Eurofighter was struck during an attack on a Saudi Arabian air base, with the defence minister confirming no Italian military personnel were involved or harmed.

stories.title: Roma, studente di 13 anni accoltella la prof in classe e si filma con il cellulare

en.title: Rome, 13-year-old student stabs teacher in class and films himself with mobile phone
en.summary: A 13-year-old student stabbed a teacher during a class at a Rome school in the Collatina area and recorded the incident on his phone. The student also used pepper spray but was stopped by another student.

stories.title: Colpito in Arabia un Eurofighter italiano, si trovava in una base sotto attacco

en.title: Italian Eurofighter hit in Saudi Arabia, was at base under attack
en.summary: An Italian Eurofighter stationed at a Saudi Arabian air base under attack was struck during the assault. The defence minister stated the aircraft was in a remote area and no Italian military personnel were harmed.

stories.title: Al via “Napoli città mondo” per promuovere la sua cultura e le sue imprese

en.title: Naples City World launches to promote its culture and enterprises
en.summary: A new cultural promotion program called Naples City World has been launched by Italy's Foreign Ministry to showcase the city's culture and business sector.

stories.title: Biometano, in cantiere 398 impianti per 1,3 miliardi di metri cubi

en.title: Biomethane: 398 plants under construction for 1.3 billion cubic meters
en.summary: A total of 398 biomethane plants have received government incentives through PNRR funding, with a combined capacity of 1.3 billion cubic meters.

stories.title: Leadership femminile: un tema di innovazione, qualità e competitività

en.title: Female leadership: a matter of innovation, quality and competitiveness
en.summary: The Lead Her Way 2026 initiative, sponsored by Range Rover, held its third event focusing on leadership, competitiveness, innovation and human capital.

stories.title: Vino: primo positivo rimbalzo dell’export italiano negli Stati Uniti

en.title: Wine: first significant rebound in Italian export sales to the United States
en.summary: Italian wine exports to the United States experienced their first significant rebound in July, according to European Commission data analyzed by the Italian Wine Union Observatory.

stories.title: Sea investe 600 milioni per la crescita di Malpensa

en.title: Sea invests 600 million for Malpensa growth
en.summary: Sea is investing 600 million euros in Malpensa airport's expansion, with major projects including the enlargement of Terminal 1 toward the north.
